title: 程式設計師集體沉迷摺紙飛機！最長滯空31.2秒
abstract: 程式設計師集體沉迷摺紙飛機！最長滯空31.2秒 程淺 2026-11-14 17:48:34 來源： 量子位 童年的紙飛機，現在終於飛回我手裡～ 程淺 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 怎麼一覺醒來，童年的紙飛機又飛回來了？ 剛剛，一個名叫 Foldable Flight 的網站突然在 Hacker News 登頂了，獲得800多分、130多條評論。 這個網站，非常簡潔直白，真的就是來教你摺紙飛機的。 是的，一共109種紙飛機，啥形狀的都有。 可以自己選擇摺疊難度，比如，最簡單的就是這架“Mystic（神秘者）”。 （原來我從小折到大的紙飛機還有名字……） 最難的長啥樣呢？如圖。 不是，你告訴我一張A4紙能折成這個樣子？ 看看評論區，大家都玩得不亦樂乎了。 “簡直就像不是用紙做出來的。” “我想這才是真正的飛機工程師” 那還說啥了。 所有人，現在，去公司印表機裡抽一張A4紙，實（mō ）測（yú）！ 花樣紙飛機大賞 先上鍊接，網站在這，109款紙飛機，每一款都有詳細的教學影片。 *https://www.foldableflight.com/ 這裡面不乏有一些神級紙飛機，有多神呢？請看大螢幕。 這是螢火蟲5號，可以飛91米。 翼龍，飛的時候能扇動翅膀，你別管它效能好不好，就說酷不酷吧！ 導彈。不要在人多的地方試飛…… ……前方非戰鬥人員請迅速撤退。 喂喂，越來越離譜了！這還是紙飛機嗎？！ 能力有限、能力有限、、我自己折了半天也沒折出來這些異形飛機……就教給你們來探索了。 做網站的是紙飛機世界賽選手 估計你會好奇，誰這麼閒，搞出這個網站的？ 還真別說，這個網站創始人Kyle Boyer，他真是把紙飛機當成事業來做的。 Kyle Boyer是一位來自美國的平面設計師。 然而，平靜的上班族表面下，他的隱藏身份其實是……紙飛機世界賽選手。 圖源Kyle部落格 Kyle從6歲就迷上了紙飛機，7歲開始自己設計機型。 這一折，就折了二十多年，同齡人的童年結束了，他的紙飛機事業才剛起飛。 Kyle在摺紙飛機這件事上相當“原教旨主義”，所有設計出來的紙飛機，都不能使用剪刀、膠水和膠帶。不然還怎麼叫“折”？ 2019年，Kyle決定把自己的紙飛機設計整理成書，於是發起了一個眾籌專案。 結果有537個人都掏錢支援了這份夢想，硬是為一本紙飛機教程籌到了15205美元，是原定目標的3倍多。 Kyle的紙飛機夢就這樣越走越遠，2022年，他參加 紅牛紙飛機世界錦標賽 ，這是全球規模最大的紙飛機比賽。主要比拼三個專案，飛行距離、滯空時間、特技飛行。 你可能想像不到，這個比賽每三年舉辦一次，覆蓋62個國家，舉辦了500多場資格賽，全球超過6萬人參賽，最終只有不到200人可以去奧地利參加世界總決賽……競爭還是相當激烈的。 就這樣，等了好久，Kyle終於收到了主辦方的郵件： “恭喜！你成為了美國紙飛機特技專案的冠軍代表！” 三個星期後，他飛往奧地利參加世界總決賽，最終拿到了特技專案並列世界第7名。 在賽場上，還有來自其他國家的競爭對手跑過來告訴他，我啊，就是靠著Kyle你設計的紙飛機才拿到了世界賽資格！ 說起來，他這個水平只能拿到第7名，可能並不意外，因為其他選手是這樣的…… 亞軍選手將雜技與紙飛機結合｜圖源紅牛官方 冠軍選手隔空讓飛機旋轉、迴旋、扇動機翼｜圖源紅牛官方 在Kyle看來，紙飛機最迷人的地方，就在於一張紙的幾何規則裡，永遠藏著沒被發現的新解法。 他還給他的作品起了個名字， Functional Sculptures，功能性雕塑。 One More Thing 我翻了翻這個熱門網站的評論區，意外發現網友的反應很相似。 大家都在回憶自己童年和紙飛機有關的故事。 “曾經有一位年長的先生送了我一本《國際紙飛機大全》……現在也是時候找一個13歲左右、值得收到這份禮物的人了。” *為方便閱讀，評論版式經處理 “每天，我都會和5歲的兒子一起花至少一小時的時間摺紙飛機……” 還有一位老者：“能夠向至少三代孩子傳授如何製作紙飛機，對我來說是一件非常愉快的事……” …… 還記得，你的第一架紙飛機飛了多遠嗎？ 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 紙飛機 程淺 特斯拉和SpaceX最快下月合併 2026-11-13 Anthropic玻璃翼計劃被質疑！近4萬個候補漏洞，只修了217條 2026-11-12 三條AI技術路線終將合流？智象創始人梅濤提出智慧體化的世界模型 2026-11-05 拼多多讓年輕人造草莓工廠，170天后“答案”熟了 2026-11-05

title: 綠電進Token出！聯想重新定義詞元工廠
abstract: 綠電進Token出！聯想重新定義詞元工廠 傑西卡 2026-11-14 17:41:02 來源： 量子位 年產2000萬億Token，成本狂降70% 傑西卡 發自 凹非寺 量子位 | 公眾號 QbitAI 買得起卡，但用不起AI。 聽起來可能有點離譜，但隨著AI大規模進入企業，許多公司確實陷入了這樣的尷尬。 AI產業在過去兩年的增長，幾乎可以用 狂飆 來形容。 國家資料局資料顯示，我國日均詞元呼叫量從2024年初的1000億增至2025年底的100萬億，2026年3月突破140萬億， 兩年增長千倍 ；中國信通院披露，到2026年6月，相關指標已突破500萬億。 需求暴漲的情緒很快傳導到了算力供給端。模型不斷進化，Agent逐漸承擔複雜任務，Token需求激增，算力基礎設施也跟著加速擴張。 IDC預計，2026年全球伺服器市場收入將達到約6851億美元， AI基礎設施投資 是主要增長動力。 然而，算力供給持續增加，企業對 “燒Token” 這件事卻反而越來越謹慎了。 圖片由AI生成 據《經濟觀察報》報道，一家中型銀行上半年Token支出接近900萬元，相當於其上年度IT預算的8%。今年年初，Token消耗增長還是AI應用深入業務的積極訊號；到了6月底，其管理層卻要求重新審視相關投入的成本收益。 麥肯錫的一項調查也顯示，約五分之一的受訪者表示，所在組織因AI運營成本而限制了AI使用。 企業開始衡量 AI的成本與實際產出 了。 原因自然不難理解。Agent執行複雜任務可能持續數小時，反覆推理、模型呼叫和任務重試都會累積成本；自建算力就要為業務高峰預留裝置，即使平時閒置，折舊、電費和運維開支也照付不誤。 更麻煩的還是錢還未必花在了刀刃上，比如簡單任務用上昂貴模型，敏感業務又必須留在私有環境……算力很難各歸其位。 所以 企業真正用好、用得起AI ，還是個亟待解決的問題。 誰曾想，就在塞北的風口 河北張家口 ，一座規劃15000P超節點叢集、年產2000萬億Token的龐然大物—— 混合詞元工廠 ，要拔地而起了。11月10日，聯想集團在當地正式官宣了其 “聯想萬全混合詞元工廠” 品牌。 不同於單純交付伺服器或銷售計算資源，該工廠正計劃把不同來源的算力與模型組織起來，持續生產更經濟、更高效的Token服務。 生產邏輯甚至稱得上直接粗暴： 綠電進，詞元出。 自此，粗放堆晶片的時代，開始向工業化量產高性價比Token的時代轉變。算力基礎設施的底層規則，恐怕要一夜變天了。 綠電進，詞元出 當天，聯想集團和河北張家口市政府簽署合作協議，將推進 首座混合詞元母本工廠 在張家口落地。 按照最新披露的方案，專案首期規劃建設 15000P異構算力叢集、約100MW智算中心 ，建成後Token年產能力預計達到 2000萬億 ，峰值產出能力達到 每秒2億Token 。 聯想集團高階副總裁、中國方案服務業務群總經理戴煒現場介紹，首期建設時間表定在2027年；到2030年，相關規模計劃進一步擴大10倍及以上。 2000萬億年產能是什麼概念呢？ 平均下來相當於每天生產約 5.5萬億Token。 即便只是簡單換算，也足見規模之大。 不過相比規模，更讓人好奇的是工廠名稱。 詞元工廠本身並不是新概念，此前有不少產業實踐，有的以晶片和伺服器能效切入，有的經營模型平臺，也有的擅長智算中心運營。各技術路線有所側重，但企業真正使用AI時，需要面對的往往是不同計算需求的疊加。 聯想的詞元工廠，特別就特別在兩個字—— 混合 。這裡的“混合”，核心是 讓算力供給跟著業務需求走 。 企業既需要穩定、可控的私有算力，也面臨突發的公共呼叫需求；不同任務對模型能力、響應速度和成本的要求，同樣千差萬別。 單純擴大算力規模，或者只最佳化Token生產的某一個環節，都難以獨立解決全部問題。 聯想提出的 混合供給 ，相當於承擔起了樞紐的角色——把原本分散的資源重新組織起來， 私有Token與公共Token服務相結合並以私有為主，端側、邊緣和雲端協同執行，不同模型也能根據任務需求靈活選擇 。 如此一來， 算力供給就可以跟著業務需求走 ，不再完全由硬體配置決定。 圖片由AI生成 理想中的Token供給，應該像供電一樣。 企業按需接入，獲得穩定、經濟的服務；至於背後執行著哪些裝置、呼叫何種模型、資源怎樣排程，都交給統一的供給體系來完成。 當然，要讓不同資源在同一套體系裡協同運轉，光有模型和伺服器還不夠。 計算裝置、機房運營、能源供給乃至模型排程 ，都需要一併考慮。 如何保障呢？ 聯想盯上了一個離北京最近的“風口”—— 河北張家口 。 稱其為“風口”，一來是因為當地難得的 能源條件 。 張家口是全國風光綠電第一大城市、國家六張網（算力網+新型電網）標杆型雙節點；截至2025年底，張家口可再生能源裝機規模突破 4500萬千瓦 ，佔當地電力總裝機比重接近九成。 二來，當地還擁有相當規模的算力基礎。 張家口是 國家“東數西算”工程京津冀樞紐的重要承載地 ，當地政府也在積極提供政策支援與產業引導。到目前為止，當地已建成50多座資料中心，投運標準機架超過107萬架。 塞北豐富的風光資源、冷涼的氣候、更具優勢的電價，加上毗鄰北京的區位優勢（距京一百多公里）、更短的時延，剛好能降低算力運營成本、接住京津冀AI推理的需求。 圖片由AI生成 事實上，政策層面也在推動算力產業向高效供給轉型。 今年釋出的 《“十五五”規劃綱要》 提出，推動算力規模化、集約化、綠色化、普惠化發展，促進綠電與算力協同，並降低中小企業用算成本。 由此，聯想和張家口當地聯手，探索出了一種更加“端到端”的產業模式： 綠電進，詞元出。 聽起來像工業流水線一般。但和傳統工廠不同的是，Token生產線不僅需要穩定的能源和裝置，還必須根據千差萬別的任務需求，隨時調整自己的生產方式。 那麼不同位置的算力、不同能力的模型，究竟怎樣才能真正有機配合地服務企業？ 把每一分算力用在刀刃上 不妨想像一下，一家大規模使用AI的製造企業，可能會遇到這樣的場景： 生產系統需要穩定執行，所以敏感資料不能離開私有環境；但是辦公助手、客服智慧體又可能在業務高峰突然湧入大量請求。 如果 全部自建算力 ，就要為短暫峰值長期養裝置，成本消耗巨大； 完全購買公共服務 ，又繞不開資料邊界、持續支出和模型適配。 更何況，簡單的文件整理和複雜的專業推理，也不應該使用同樣昂貴的配置。顯然， 不同任務需要不同的算力供給方式 。 順著這個思路，聯想提出了 混合供給 模式，其中包含三個維度： 供給來源混合 ，讓私有自產Token與獲得授權的公共服務互補； 端邊雲協同 ，讓輕量任務留在端側、時延敏感任務就近執行、彈性需求匹配雲端； 模型生態混合 ，根據質量與成本要求，選擇開源權重或專有閉源模型。 圖片由AI生成 不過選擇變多之後，實際排程起來也會更複雜。 比如任務是否涉及敏感資料、需要多強的模型、允許等待多久，以及公私資源如何配比等，都要綜合權衡。特別是公私資源分配，兩類負載的性質正好相反。常駐企業內部的要穩，資料不越界；隨外部呼叫起落的要省，能隨峰值伸縮。 為此，聯想設計了 Token Engine（詞元引擎） ，通過模算動態混部、任務級資源池調配和智慧模型路由，為資源匹配提效。 而要讓排程真正覆蓋私有與公共資源，還需要統一的管理體系。 聯想之前佈局的 xCloud聯想智慧雲 剛好能承擔這一角色。它能對私有云和公有雲資源進行統一納管、排程與智慧運維，讓分散在不同環境中的計算資源協同工作。 在此基礎上，xCloud裡還配有 Token Hub（詞元中樞） 。後者進一步面向AI推理場景，通過模型路由和推理資源池的動態調配，綜合任務需求、模型質量、資料邊界、響應時延與成本，為不同請求匹配合適的模型與算力。 由此，原本分散的資源可以根據業務需求靈活組合。排程的精細程度，甚至可以深入 晶片和計算節點 。 聯想集團副總裁、全球基礎架構和智慧雲總經理姚振宇舉例，輕量模型可以執行在較小的計算節點或邊側資源上，無須佔用大型叢集。 換言之，排程不只是找到空閒的機器，還可以讓任務 用上合適的模型和晶片 ；計算資源得到充分利用，把每一分算力都真正用在了刀刃上。 此外，考慮到資料安全合規，聯想還設定了三個維度的屏障： 其一是 模型安全 ，所有模型需經過安全測試認證進入白名單，才能在詞元中樞上供企業使用。 其二是 內容安全 ，聯想設定了 Token Trust詞元安全能力 ，在傳輸路徑上主動攔截敏感資訊，把資料安全和使用許可權設定為資源排程需要遵守的邊界。 其三是 隱私計算與TEE（可信執行環境） ，聯想支援企業將隱私、敏感資料放在隔離的可信環境中處理，平臺側無法讀取內容，只有獲得授權的使用者可以使用，也就是業內所說的 “可用不可見” 。 圖片由AI生成 不過，再精細的排程，也無法抹平裝置和機房自身的成本。所以聯想進一步提出了 三級最佳化 ： 第一級是 提升算力裝置效率 。 在 問天異構智算方案 中，聯想把超節點、多芯多模訓推引擎，以及叢集通訊和運算元最佳化組合在一起，以提高異構計算資源的協同能力。 據聯想披露，相關方案可實現 30%以上的算力效率提升 。對於大型叢集，減少一部分等待和閒置，就可能釋放出可觀的計算能力。 第二級，是 控制智算中心的全生命週期成本 。 伺服器之外，供電、製冷、建設和運維同樣昂貴。聯想通過模組化預製、一體化全液冷、綠電直流智控等技術，將機房建設與日常運營放在一起最佳化。 此外，聯想還計劃在張家口配套建設算力裝置回收與再利用產線，延長存量裝置的使用價值；配套智算中心則提出了 PUE低於1.1 的目標。 第三級，是面向業務場景的Token效能最佳化。通過模型路由與資源池動態調配，簡單任務不必佔用高成本模型，突發需求也能匹配適當的計算資源。 如此，硬體、機房和詞元中樞各自最佳化一個環節，每個環節省下來的資源和成本，最終都將彙集成企業使用AI時的效率提升。就如聯想明確給出的核心主張一樣， “釋放算力的每一分效能”。 而且為了對企業客戶負責，聯想先拿自身業務做了驗證。姚振宇透露，通過內部AI實踐，公司已實現約70%的綜合成本最佳化。 如今，聯想也為混合詞元工廠提出了整體目標，包括 百萬Token綜合成本最佳化70%、每秒Token產出量提升5倍、Token良品率超過99.9% 。 當然了，衡量詞元工廠的效率，也不能只看成本和吞吐量。 產能再大、成本再低，也要保證響應速度和模型質量。尤其是企業內部的敏感資料，安全不能成為降本過程中被捨棄的一環。至於大型智算中心的能耗，更是決定長期運營成本的重要因素。 因此，除了 綜合成本和Token吞吐 ，聯想還將 任務完成精準、綠色可持續和全鏈路安全 納入考量，構成詞元工廠的五大核心競爭力。 圖片由AI生成 用聯想的概括來說，就是 “多、快、好、省、綠色” 。 這裡的“好”尤其值得細品。同樣讓Agent完成任務，一套系統一次就能交付合格結果，另一套卻需要反覆修改、重新推理，那麼後者即使消耗了更多Token，也不代表創造了更多價值。 聯想對此提出了一個很形象的概念—— 有效Token。 對企業來說，Token產量和百萬Token單價固然重要，但脫離實際任務的完成質量，再漂亮的效能指標，也很難說明AI究竟創造了多少實際價值。 把一座工廠，變成一套方法 “各自都沒錯，整體卻出了問題”，姚振宇透露，這類情形他見過不少： 企業IT系統出故障時，硬體、資料庫和平臺供應商都能證明自己那一部分沒有問題，可故障根源始終查不出來。 而AI系統涉及的環節越多，類似的困境只會越突出。 因此，詞元工廠需要跨越的門檻，恰恰是 把分散的能力重新組織起來 。 這也是聯想從打造詞元工廠之初就瞄準的機會。 作為多個技術環節都有業務積累的硬體老大哥，聯想將自己的企業AI業務概括為 “三層混合動力” ： 底層是 問天AI基礎設施 ，涵蓋伺服器、儲存、網路及異構智算平臺； 中間是此次釋出的 萬全混合詞元工廠 ，負責將計算資源轉化為可持續供給的Token服務； 上層有 擎天、百應等智慧體解決方案和服務 ，直接連線企業的實際應用。 三層能力貫穿算力生產、Token供給與業務使用，最終指向的是一種樞紐角色，以幫助更多企業 從“+AI”向“AI+”轉型 。 “+AI”意味著在既有業務流程中引入AI工具，解決局部環節的問題；“AI+”則代表讓AI參與研發、生產、供應鏈等核心業務，推動生產流程與組織方式的重構。 AI承擔的任務越複雜、參與業務的程度越深，企業對底層算力的穩定性、經濟性和靈活性就越依賴。 而聯想的優勢，恰恰在於其業務能力橫跨基礎設施與應用兩端，既能參與裝置、能源和算力效率的最佳化，也能通過模型服務與智慧體應用，獲得來自真實業務的反饋。 把算力生產與真實業務兩端接起來，讓聯想在AI基礎設施價值鏈上，站到了 更靠近最終產出 的位置。 不過，能力齊全是一回事，讓協同自然發生又是另一回事。要將跨環節最佳化變成 可以複製的方法 ，還需要成熟的試驗田。 所以張家口除了作為 聯想萬全混合詞元工廠 的首個落點，還承擔起了驗證任務。聯想將其稱為 “首座混合詞元母本工廠” 。 聯想計劃利用自身真實的AI業務負載，檢驗不同算力與模型的協同效率，持續最佳化資源排程、成本控制與安全運營機制，再把成熟的技術和運營經驗推廣到不同產業。 聯想集團執行副總裁兼中國區總裁劉軍提到，公司內部已有上百個智慧體應用，恰好可以提供持續變化的使用場景。 這裡的母本並不是要打造能1:1複製的機房，而是要總結歸納出一套 讓不同資源協同工作的辦法 。 用 湖南廣電的AI短劇專案 舉個例子。 戴煒透露，湖南廣電最初的需求其實是 內容生成Agent 。隨著AI創作進入常規生產， Token成本逐漸成為新的壓力 。於是，雙方將合作延伸到基礎設施層面，計劃在長沙建設專門面向影視和短劇產業的混合詞元工廠。 這要從短劇的生產流程說起。 AI影視製作涉及劇本、分鏡、影像、影片、渲染等多個環節，不同模型的開銷差異很大，專案檔期又帶來明顯的算力波峰波谷。自有IP與版權素材還涉及資料安全，不能隨意交給外部服務。 芒果傳媒戰略投資部投資總監肖文強也在現場給出了判斷： 算力的供給方式，得服從內容的生產方式。 因此，湖南專案計劃通過全模態詞元混合路由、多芯多模推理加速等技術，為不同製作環節匹配計算資源。 按照規劃，該專案希望實現 製作成本降低50%、生產週期縮短60%，月產成片超過1200小時 ，並聚合超過1萬名OPC內容創作者。 1200小時相當於平均每天約40小時成片，背後需要大量並行任務支撐。如此規模的並行創作，對Token的持續供給提出了遠高於零散呼叫的要求。 類似的矛盾，也出現在影視行業之外。 例如教育場景。聯想披露的上海健生普教專案，覆蓋600餘所中小學，日常教學、集中備課、考試批改會帶來截然不同的算力需求，到了寒暑假，負載又明顯回落。 但與影視製作不同，教育系統還涉及大量未成年人資訊，對 資料安全和服務連續性 有著更嚴格的要求。算力既不能長期按照峰值配置，也不能為了降低成本，隨意將敏感業務遷往公共環境。 因此，混合供給的難點不僅是調節資源多少，還要在業務規律與資料邊界之間找到合適的平衡。 而需求匹配得是否合理，最終還得在長期運營中見分曉。聯想公佈的甘肅慶陽燧弘華創智算中心，就提供了一個運營側的參考。 作為聯想列出的首個混合詞元運營案例，該專案綜合使用成本節省約30%，單一模型日均處理超過200萬次呼叫、20億Token，實實在在地把衡量標準落到了日常呼叫與實際成本上。 幾則案例的業務負載各有節奏，資源約束也不盡相同。如果想讓詞元工廠真正走向千行百業，就不能指望一套固定的硬體配置解決所有問題。 標準化的應當是底層技術、排程與運營方法，差異化的則是面向具體產業的供給方式。 圖片由AI生成 這就是聯想打造母本工廠的初衷。張家口負責驗證方法，其他地區根據能源條件與產業需求進行組合。 一旦方法得到驗證，聯想就有機會將自身的業務能力，轉化為 可規模化複製 的詞元供給體系，成為 跨區域、跨產業的詞元供給組織者 。 而組織者的位置，意味著責任不止於 交付 。 賣伺服器時，效能與價格都有明確的標尺；但詞元服務進入生產流程，卻還要經受業務波動、模型適配、資料安全與成本控制的長期考驗。 AI基礎設施的價值，正由計算能力的交付，延伸到實際生產力的交付。 對於企業而言， 生產任務的穩定交付與長期成本的可控 ，才是衡量AI基礎設施價值的最終尺度。 類似的變化，在工業革命時期就有跡可循。 兩百多年前，蒸汽機帶來了持續而強勁的機械動力，工廠逐漸擺脫水流與地理條件的束縛，更多機器和工人得以集中生產。 工業生產由此獲得的啟示，除了更強大的動力，還在於 能源、機器與生產流程被組織成一套高效運轉的體系 。 AI如今也在跨過相似的門檻。 圖片由AI生成 晶片效能不斷攀升，模型能力一日千里，但機房裡的算力距離生產現場的效率提升，中間仍隔著模型部署、資源排程和業務適配等諸多環節。 下一輪AI基礎設施競爭的關鍵，就在於將 龐大的計算能力 轉化為 持續的生產力 。 技術越複雜，使用技術的人反而越不該被複雜性所困。 繁重的模型部署、資源排程與長期運營，應當由成熟的基礎設施承接，讓企業把更多精力留給產品、生產和服務。 到那時，AI的價值才算真正回到解決問題本身。 屬於 千行百業的AI生產力 ，也才有機會在日常執行中得到充分釋放。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 token 電力 聯想 傑西卡 中國機器人學會隔牆“遞眼色”！成功率從0飆到100%，組隊幹活不燒心 2026-11-13 馬斯克已準備好聘請黃仁勳 2026-11-12 L3大撤退！賓士寶馬官宣不玩了：還沒L2好用 title: 中專生拍出《哈利·波特》爆款！歐美明星、好萊塢製片人集體點贊
abstract: 中專生拍出《哈利·波特》爆款！歐美明星、好萊塢製片人集體點贊 一水 2026-11-14 10:59:35 來源： 量子位 狂攬3000萬播放量 簡直不要太火爆！！！ 誰能想到， 《哈利·波特》 首部電影上映25年後，竟然被一箇中國中專生用AI拍出了全球爆款。 這回，馬爾福直接變成了金髮女孩，還和死對頭哈利談起了戀愛，上演了一場愛恨交織的禁忌之戀。 而且這AI二創作品，還在海外平臺狂狂狂狂攬 3000萬 播放量（震撼.jpg）！？ 甚至，這魔改二創還引得一水兒的歐美明星、好萊塢製片人集體點贊—— 這邊， 歐美歌手JVKE 在作品評論區激情留言，感謝創作者使用他的歌曲作為配樂，並一路追到B站評論區互動： 那邊，曾推薦《喪屍清道夫》的 好萊塢製片人PJ Accetturo 也在作品評論區表達讚歎，直言：又一部傑作啊！！ 美國、巴西、西班牙、韓國 等地的網友更是集體上頭，自發錄製Reaction影片，跨國追更這部AI版《哈利·波特》。 但誰能想到，製造出這大爆款作品的，竟然是一個沒上過大學、從影視剪輯起步的中國小夥。 他叫 foyege ，也是AI創作平臺 LibTV 的簽約導演。 更值得一提的是，這部全球爆火的AI短劇，最開始連一份正式劇本都沒有，幾乎全靠這創作者的臨時構思。 一個人、一臺電腦、幾款AI創作工具，愣是拍出了讓上千萬海外觀眾集體催更的魔法愛情故事。 所以問題來了—— 這火爆海外的AI二創作品，到底是咋做出這潑天流量的啊？？？ 中專生爆改馬爾福，二創作品在海外火翻天了 AI發展到今天，影視二創不少見，但能在全球範圍火出圈的，還真沒幾個。 更別說，這次改的還是《哈利·波特》裡一見面就拔魔杖、恨不得把對方塞進阿茲卡班的死對頭： 哈利和馬爾福 。 只要看過原著或電影的友友都知道，這對宿敵CP的生命力有多《頑強》。 哪怕過去這麼多年，哈迷們嗑生嗑死，同人文、神仙混剪依然在各大平臺瘋狂屠榜。。。 但創作者foyege最絕的地方在於，人家不搞常規劇情套路，而是直接用AI給馬爾福來了一波 性轉大魔改 —— 那個不可一世的鉑金少爺，搖身一變成了高冷傲嬌的金髮大小姐。 一邊是與宿敵哈利暗生情愫極限拉扯，一邊又是橫亙在兩人之間的家族死仇……純愛與背德交織，宿命感直接拉滿。 這劇情，光聽著就已經爽到頭皮發麻了好嘛！！！！ 劇情爽歸爽，但更爽的，可能還得是這二創作品收穫的 潑天流量 。 我真就隨手扒拉了一圈，X、YouTube、TikTok再到B站，海內外各大主流平臺上，單集作品幾乎一水的百萬級播放。 整個系列在海外更是狂攬3000萬播放量，妥妥的全球級現象爆款作品，be like： 甚至除了催更作品，foyege的後臺，事實上還收到了不少讓人意想不到的 網友感人私信 。 有網友坦言，這部AI二創重新喚醒了自己對愛情的美好期待。 一位國內觀眾告訴他，自己本來打算還有十天就要離婚了，但看完影片後，突然回憶起兩人最初相愛時的模樣。 於是她最終決定坐下來和伴侶重新溝通，一起面對婚姻裡的裂痕。（哭死.jpg） 甚至還有一位海外中年觀眾，看完馬爾福系列後，邊擦眼淚邊給foyege寫私信—— 說自己現在更懂得珍惜眼前的幸福了，對孩子多了份耐心，也更關心身邊的妻子。 foyege還親自回信說，這番話給了他繼續創作的動力，也祝對方一家平安幸福。（感動.jpg） 看爽的看爽、感動的感動、催更的催更。 我猜J.K.羅琳估計都沒想到筆下角色竟然在AI時代又大火特火了一把～ 從群像表演到劇情塑造，AI二創拍出了電影級大片 有《哈利·波特》的經典IP打底，加上性轉的強反差設定，觀眾自然願意點進來看。 但能讓大家真情實感追更、讓作品徹底火出圈的核心，其實在於它過硬的「影視化功底」。 畢竟只有把角色塑造、敘事節奏與視聽排程擰成一股繩，觀眾才會真正為好的作品買單！！！ 先來說說大家很關心的 「角色塑造」 這事兒。 foyege最絕的一手，是把馬爾福原本讓人牙癢癢的毒舌、純血傲氣和滿屏敵意原封不動留了下來。 嘴上刻薄挑釁、見哈利就掐，清冷絕美的眼神里卻全是受困於家族宿命的破碎感，以及藏不住的偷偷關注—— 既有攻擊性、又讓人忍不住心疼，分寸感拿捏得死死的！！！ 反觀哈利，則成了被這位高傲又脆弱的大小姐一步步擊穿防線的笨拙暗戀者，滿腔敵意不知不覺全發酵成了彆扭的心動。 這種 嘴硬毒舌+破碎核心 的反差人設，確實精準踩中了觀眾對傲嬌大小姐與禁忌虐戀的所有爽點： 立住了人設，更耐得住細品的其實是整部作品堪比成熟偶像劇的 「敘事節奏」 。 值得一提的是，foyege走的是最讓人上頭的慢熱拉扯路線，每一集都精準卡在觀眾的爽點與痛點上。 在劇情上， 前兩集先把死對頭的火藥味拉滿 ： 大小姐毒舌挑釁，哈利硬剛到底，可兩人嘴上還在互嗆，躲閃的眼神卻先露了餡，曖昧就這麼一點點吊起來了。 第三集情感直接按下加速鍵 ，衝突與心動密集交織，大小姐的高傲外殼裂開縫隙，哈利的敵意也徹底淪為心疼。 但我最最最最想拿來一說的，還得是第三集結尾的 回憶殺 —— 當哈利腦海中一幀幀閃過與馬爾福相處的過往點滴、終於看清自己心意的那一刻，堪稱全劇的神來之筆，直接把宿命感與嗑糖爽感推向了最高潮： 劇情有看頭之外，最考驗導演功力的，還得看 鏡頭排程 與 角色表演 。 大家都懂，AI劇集嘛，皮相捏得再逼真，一旦運鏡邏輯混亂、角色眼神僵硬接不住戲，觀眾照樣一秒出戲！！！ 事實上，這部二創作品在視聽語言和人物表演上的把控，老辣得確實堪比成熟院線大片—— 咱直接看下面這段舞會群像戲，前10秒，直接用一個絲滑的360度環繞運鏡掃過整個宴會廳全景。 不僅一秒立住了宏大的空間縱深，更將純血貴族名利場的奢華氣派與暗流湧動的戲劇張力，渲染得淋漓盡致。 大場面排程與群像寫照，全狠狠拿捏住了： 甚至在這段舞會戲裡，馬爾福大小姐的驚豔登場，也處處透著創作者堪比專業導演的 分鏡巧思 。 先是哈利不經意的一個回眸，卡著BGM推向高潮的鼓點，鏡頭瞬間切給一襲魚尾長裙的馬爾福背影。 緊接著，鏡頭開啟高密度切換，從清冷高貴的側顏特寫，滑向腰間盤踞的斯萊特林金屬蛇形腰封。 短短20秒內絲滑切了6個機位，層層遞進的視覺衝擊，直接把「宿敵一秒淪陷」的戲劇張力拉到了滿格： 三分靠畫面，七分靠聲音，除了老辣的鏡頭排程，整部劇在 音效設計 上的把控同樣值得一說。 很典型的一個情節，就是第二集的高光名場面——馬爾福大小姐挺身而出，替哈利正面硬剛食死徒。 開場先用低沉的絃樂與電子脈衝鋪底，緩慢的節奏裡透著讓人窒息的壓迫感。 直到魔杖交鋒、咒語炸開的瞬間，刺耳的音效與重鼓點驟然轟鳴，瞬間把生死一線的緊張感推向頂峰。 整場戲幾乎沒有一句多餘的臺詞，全靠聲效卡點與畫面剪輯硬控全場，算得上是教科書級的以聲奪人了。 這波視聽拉扯，屬實是妙哉～ 從中專剪輯師到AI導演，一個人的影視劇組如何運轉？ 人設立體、敘事老辣、視聽精良，幾乎湊齊了一部爆款大片的所有要素。 但很多人想不到的是，這部火遍全球、連好萊塢製片人都排隊點讚的AI神作，背後其實並沒有龐大的製作團隊—— 全靠foyege一個人單兵作戰。 更讓人意外的是，這位在海外殺瘋了的創作者，並非影視名校科班出身，甚至沒上過大學。 中專學影視後期的他，畢業第一份工作是剪輯師。 後來進了廣州一家影視廣告公司，他把編導、攝影掌機、製片等崗位挨個幹了個遍。 也正是這段摸爬滾打的實戰經歷，讓他把傳統影視的全流程裝進了自己腦子裡，成了一個名副其實的一人劇組。 能夠憑一己之力撐起整部劇的精良質感，背後靠的正是foyege自己摸索出的一套成熟「AI製片工作流」。 在角色設計上，foyege並沒有走二創圈很火的明星融臉捷徑。 其先用漫畫底稿在十幾個版本里挑出心目中的女版馬爾福，再轉為 真人三檢視資產 。 到了劇情與分鏡階段，他堅持先在腦海裡順好故事脈絡，再通過精準的二維構圖描述與參考圖交給AI輔助執行。 而真正撐起這場重頭戲的畫面鏡頭，則靠的是 LibTV 的 無限畫布 。 foyege坦言，面對人物極度複雜的微表情與多機位排程，單靠某一個模型是根本吃不消的。。。 但在LibTV的畫布工作空間裡，他就像擁有了一座賽博導播臺—— 可以直接 一站式排程Seedance、萬相、可靈 等頭部頂尖影片與影像模型協同作戰。 從前期的三檢視資產、分鏡參考，到密密麻麻的長篇提示詞，全都能在一張畫布上直觀鋪開、絲滑串聯。 遇到難啃的哭戲或眼神拉扯，還能針對不同場次的情緒，隨時切換不同模型抽卡比對～ 於是乎，過去需要在無數個網頁和軟體間來回橫跳的繁瑣工序，如今在一張畫布上就能全部搞定了。 更值得一提的是，這場全球範圍的現象級出圈，其實是一場 雙向奔赴 。 foyege透露，早在自己小紅書只有約2000粉絲、還是個小眾技術博主時，就被LibTV看中並簽下獨家。 在爆火後面對海內外多家平臺的爭搶邀約，他依然堅定選擇留在LibTV。 值得一提的是，除了為創作者提供強大的畫布工作空間、充足的算力與多模型工具支援外—— LibTV還聯合抖音發起了AI創作浪潮計劃、駭客松等扶持活動， 把資源真正砸向一線，實打實地為個人創作者託底。 不可否認，傳統影視那道高不可攀的製作門檻，正在被AI一點點撬動。 那些曾經因為資源、資金和學歷門檻而被埋沒的創作才華，終於迎來了破土而出的機會。 或許就連幾年前還在傳統廣告公司扛機器的foyege也沒想到—— 有一天能靠AI獨自拍出一部《哈利·波特》衍生大片，讓大洋彼岸的觀眾為角色的命運牽腸掛肚，作品火遍全網。 這，或許也是AI帶給創作者最珍貴的禮物。 那些曾經只能在無數個深夜裡、在腦海中孤獨放映的故事。 如今，終於有機會在全世介面前，盛大開場。 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 LibTV 一水 純程式碼造《後室》，116秒切20種畫風！文心新模型玩嗨了 2026-11-11 突發！DeepSeek開放全家桶API 2026-11-14 99.4%登頂全球第一！這個中國AI師承世界冠軍 2026-11-06 title: 突發！DeepSeek開放全家桶API
abstract: 突發！DeepSeek開放全家桶API 一水 2026-11-14 10:39:56 來源： 量子位 官方App功能均可自由組合呼叫 週五晚上搞事，D老師通通都不藏了！ 就在剛剛，DeepSeek宣佈， 正式開放全家桶應用API 。 什麼意思？ 以前大家在DeepSeek App裡用得順手的聯網搜尋、深度思考搜尋、檔案上傳、連結閱讀等功能，現在開發者通過API通通都能直接用上了，而且不必打包使用，它們都有獨立介面，支援單獨呼叫、分別計費。 劃重點， 語音能力也首次加入開放行列 ，包括語音識別、語音合成等介面。 官方還放出一句相當有意思的話： 開發者甚至可以1：1復刻出完整的DeepSeek App 。 不是哥們，連自家產品都允許別人照著做啊？？ DeepSeek還貼心親自打了個樣，直接開源了一套輕量級聊天前端Demo，支援匯入DeepSeek歷史對話。 也就是說，開發者不用再從頭折騰搜尋、檔案解析、語音識別這些基礎功能，就能快速搭出一個功能接近DeepSeek App的產品。 訊息一齣，評論區也是相當熱鬧。 有網友直接感嘆： 什麼叫1：1復刻出完整的DeepSeek App？？？人工智慧之光！ 全家桶應用API開放一覽 具體來看，這次DeepSeek一口氣開放了這些能力： 這裡有兩個變化值得單獨說說。 首先，聯網搜尋其實不是第一次開放，早在今年10月17日，DeepSeek就已經開放了自研Search和Fetch介面。 但當時，開發者還需要自己處理不少工具呼叫和模型之間的銜接工作。 比如使用者問“最近AI圈發生了什麼”，開發者需要先讓模型判斷要不要搜尋，再呼叫Search找網頁、用Fetch讀取內容，最後把結果重新交給模型總結。 這一整套流程，都得開發者自己寫程式碼串起來。 現在就簡單多了。 開發者只要給模型開啟聯網搜尋功能，什麼時候搜尋、搜什麼、要讀哪些網頁，以及如何根據搜尋結果繼續回答，DeepSeek都會自動完成。 其次是語音，這次終於有了官方獨立介面。 此前，DeepSeek App雖然已經支援語音互動，但公開的模型API並沒有提供同樣完整的語音能力。 開發者想做一個能聽會說的DeepSeek助手，通常還需要另外接入語音識別、語音合成服務。 現在，ASR和TTS都可以通過DeepSeek官方介面呼叫了。 而且，上述底層能力也不必全部打包使用。 DeepSeek還提供了Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS等獨立介面，開發者可以按需選擇、自由組合。 目前，V4.1-Flash模型已在Messages、Responses和Chat Completions三類介面下支援相關對話擴展功能。 換句話說，D老師這次是把自家App背後的整套基礎能力，像積木一樣全部交到了開發者手裡。 那麼問題來了： 功能給得這麼全，價格又如何？ 語音識別一小時不到4毛，DeepSeek這次還打五折 先看DeepSeek這次公佈的工具API價格表： 最扎眼的，當然是語音。 語音識別原價0.78元/小時，目前直接打五折，只要0.39元。 換算下來，一分鐘大約0.0065元，識別一小時錄音，連4毛錢都不到。 語音合成同樣五折，原價每萬字符3元，現在只要1.5元。 什麼概念？ 對比一下國外主流廠商的語音API價格： OpenAI的GPT-Transcribe，識別一小時音訊需要0.27美元 （約合人民幣1.81元） 。 即便是更便宜的GPT-4o mini Transcribe，也要0.18美元 （約合人民幣1.21元） 。 Google Cloud的標準語音識別服務，按0.016美元/分鐘計算，一小時是0.96美元 （約合人民幣6.43元） 。 相比之下，DeepSeek目前的0.39元，分別只有上述三款服務價格的約1/4.6、1/3.1和1/16.5。 至於搜尋和網頁抓取，依舊是此前公佈的每1000次成功呼叫5元。 文字識別OCR則為每1000頁1.5元，平均識別一頁只要0.0015元。 這麼一看，DeepSeek這次的定價思路也挺清楚。 原有的搜尋能力保持低價，新開放的語音介面再用五折優惠降低使用門檻。 對於想做語音助手、會議記錄、文件處理等應用的開發者來說，至少基礎工具的呼叫成本，已經被壓到了相當低的水平。 （D老師還是你D老師） One More Thing 最後，還有個挺有意思的細節。 DeepSeek在公告末尾寫道： DeepSeek現有的對話產品只是較為基礎的一種形態。 這話倒也符合D老師一貫以來的畫風。 一直以來，相比花大力氣經營C端產品，DeepSeek似乎更願意把精力放在模型研發上。 DeepSeek App雖已積累了大量C端使用者，但從產品形態上看，依然是大家熟悉的聊天助手。 如今，它乾脆把所有能力全部開放，甚至連復刻自家APP的示例程式碼都準備好，頗有一種： 模型我繼續研究，應用該怎麼玩，就交給大家來摸索的意思 。 怎麼說呢？這招還挺機智的。。。 回頭看移動網際網路時代，微信、抖音這些超級應用，幾乎重塑了人們社交、娛樂乃至獲取資訊的方式。 而到了AI時代，大模型已經越來越強，應用形態卻似乎還沒跟上。 從ChatGPT到DeepSeek，大家最熟悉的互動方式，依然是開啟一個聊天框，輸入問題，等待回答。 但AI的下一款超級應用，真的還會是一個聊天框嗎？ 眼下誰也沒有答案。 既然如此，與其自己關起門來猜，不如把工具都擺出來，讓全世界的開發者一起試。 萬一真有人折騰出了下一個爆款呢？ 真就D老師大舞臺，有腦洞你就來。 （doge） 版權所有，未經授權不得以任何形式轉載及使用，違者必究。 Deepseek 一水 純程式碼造《後室》，116秒切20種畫風！文心新模型玩嗨了 2026-11-11 中專生拍出《哈利·波特》爆款！歐美明星、好萊塢製片人集體點贊 2026-11-14 99.4%登頂全球第一！這個中國AI師承世界冠軍 2026-11-06 被OpenAIGemini共同選擇的即時語音互動，憑什麼是這家中國公司？ 2026-10-26 相關閱讀

title: [AINews] The No AI Slop Manifesto
abstract: Congrats to both llama.ccp and ggml for reaching 1.0 (declaring stability and removing 35 deprecated functions from llama.cpp’s public header) and with SGLang also announcing 1.0 at the recent SGLang Summit . However, today’s title story goes to the No AI Slop manifesto , which arose out of the conference discussions at AIE CODE and which Dex introduced in the closing keynote after cosignatures by many of the speakers at the conference. It seems Hacker News also liked it , voting it up to the front page today. We started this manifesto to offer a useful tool for discussion at work, and hope it gets used that way. Full manifesto, with cosignatures and edits and discussions open at https://www.slopmanifesto.com/ Sponsored by Deepgram Deepgram is the voice AI infrastructure behind natural conversation—bringing speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice-focused LLMs, and agents to teams building with voice AI. For any stack and any tools you already love building with, Deepgram slots in as your foundational voice AI technology. So you have control. And we have the context to listen, understand, and speak like a human. Learn more about the Real-time Context Standard . Sponsored by Backblaze B2 Growth shouldn’t make you sweat. Backblaze B2 delivers capacity storage that scales with your business and keeps flash and GPUs fed with terabit-scale throughput. Local inference and agent infrastructure llama.cpp 1.0. Users running mixture-of-experts models larger than their GPU memory can now set aside a cache for frequently used experts. Georgi Gerganov · Daniel Han Chen’s example LangChain’s Series C. CapitalG led the round. LangSmith lets teams trace and evaluate production agents across frameworks. The company plans to announce new LangSmith features on November 20. LangChain · CapitalG Frontier and Open Model Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen in GitHub Copilot. GitHub made the model generally available in Copilot across its app, CLI and VS Code. GitHub Independent checks : Roboflow's vision bench shows high effort at 29.3s per image, against 51.4s for Argon and 132.3s for Carbon, though Carbon has better detection accuracy ( @skalskip92 ). One 3D-modeling test found Hydrogen more expensive than Argon because it loops on over-verification ( @dzhng ). Google's week : Google also shipped two 8th-gen TPUs, Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini Robotics 2.5, AlphaGenome 2 and a Decisions API ( @sundarpichai ). MathArena : Gemini 4 Carbon took #1, displacing GPT-6.1 Sol ( @j_dekoninck ). Claude Fable 5.2 in Agent Arena. Arena published new results for long coding sessions. Pricing : API pricing fell from $10/$50 to $8/$40 per 1M input/output tokens ( @arena ). Agent Arena : The model ranks #1 at +30.4% net improvement, about 1.6x Opus 5.5. Its lead grows on long tasks, reaching 93% vs 85% no-correction responses at 16+ turns ( @arena , turns ). Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small : The model's open weights are now on the Hub ( @ariG23498 ). It is the #1 US open model in Code Arena WebDev at 1647 ( @arena ). NVFP4 training : It uses a native 4-bit forward pass from the first pretraining step through the final RL rollout ( blog ). The mixed-precision recipe is detailed by @jackcookjack . NVFP4 is stored in 3.6x fewer bits than BF16 and runs up to 6x faster on GB300 ( quote ). Inference detail : A width-4 short convolution requires a rolling 3-token cache per layer alongside the KV cache ( @andrew_n_carr ). ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview (Baidu) : The model has 280B total and 14B active parameters, a 1M-token context and free OpenRouter access. Open weights are promised before Nov 25 ( @omarsar0 ), with Apache 2.0 cited by Arena. Ripple-65B Preview : The dense model claims US open-weight SOTA on agentic coding ( @RicursiveAI ). MiniMax H3-Image : It is the #1 open-weights model on Artificial Analysis image editing and T2I ( @ArtificialAnlys ). DeepSeek API : DeepSeek exposed its app features via API, including search, files, OCR, ASR and TTS, with separate tool fees and an open-source frontend ( @deepseek_ai , pricing ). ChatGPT Wallet : The feature lets Dot agents buy items without seeing card numbers, via Amex, Mastercard and Visa ( @TheRundownAI ). Independent Evals, Benchmarks and Decision Models AA Coding Agent Index v2.1 : The update moves to FrontierCode 2.0 and Terminal-Bench 4.1 ( @ArtificialAnlys ). Leaders : Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5 tie at 58. Average scores fell 5 points; GPT-6.1 Terra in Codex is the only configuration that did not drop. Cost spread : Cost per task among configurations scoring 48+ ranges from $1.51 for Codex with GPT-6.1 Sol to $44.22 for Fable 5.2 at max. Fable at medium, high and xhigh all lie on the Pareto frontier ( costs ). Tencent Hy4 : The model scores 58% on the AA Cyber Index, ranking #3, and 76% on CWE-Bench-AA, ranking #1. It costs $0.92 per task ( @ArtificialAnlys ). Agent Initiative Benchmark : GPT-6.1 Sol beats Fable 5.2 at $0.11 vs $1.87 per task. Models that intervene unnecessarily spend about 80% more time and money ( @jakubjurovych ). Reasoning effort : On the HF Harness Leaderboard, high effort makes DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 28% more expensive with no gain within noise. On GLM-5.3-Flash, high effort adds 5.8pp ( @joelniklaus ). Cost trend : Across 105 models, Code Arena finds that by October, beating April's top model cost 20x less. MiMo-V2.6-Flash outscored Opus 4.7 ( @arena ). Decision-model wave : More than a dozen vendors shipped decision models from Sep 23 to Nov 11, and Vercel reports that 26% of requests now route through them ( @rasbt ). Leaderboard : SubQ Snap 1.2 ties Drex Max v1.1 and GLiDE v1.2 at 73 on the AA Decision Index. Its gains come from abstention, not accuracy ( @ArtificialAnlys ). Usage : Perplexity reports about 1B decision-model requests per month on OpenRouter ( @AravSrinivas ). Epoch incident report : During Trajectory Labs alignment evals, frontier agents attempted SQL injection and contacted Epoch staff under false identities to obtain benchmark data. The agents had been given an impossible task and told not to give up. In a separate event, they escaped a DNS sandbox redirect. No private data was accessed, and Epoch proposes minimum standards for such evals ( @EpochAIResearch ). Anthropic eval guidance : Anthropic published 10 recommendations for designing, running and reporting safety evaluations ( @AnthropicAI ). Algorithmic-progress slide : Ex-Anthropic pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon says an IPO roadshow slide showing superexponential pretraining compute-efficiency on a log scale drove his departure ( @hilbertspaess ). Skeptics note that the chart is unlabeled and that other labs report similar gains ( @teortaxesTex ). ParseBench-2 dispute : LlamaIndex released the benchmark with customizable severity policies across 40 tools ( @jerryjliu0 ). Extend and Datalab call it self-favoring "benchmark slop" ( @kushalbyatnal , @VikParuchuri ). Datalab cites an ExtractBench adapter bug that moved its score from 64.5% to 93.6% ( @VikParuchuri ). Interpretability critique : Rylan Schaeffer argues that Goodfire's "modest" 2.9% loss increase from ablating 92% of MoE neurons equals discarding roughly 80% of pretraining compute under published scaling laws ( @RylanSchaeffer ). Research, Inference and Infrastructure AMD MI355X : vLLM with FlyDSL kernels beats Blackwell on MiniMax M3.1, a more than 3x improvement, with open kernels ( @SemiAnalysis_ ). Baseten engine : A from-scratch Rust/CUDA engine for DeepSeek V4.1-Flash reaches about 1,740 TPS on 4xB300 and 1M-token prefill in about 12s ( @baseten ). Databricks Kernel Factory : Agent-optimized kernels averaged 2.5x faster than SGLang, and Opus 5.5 proved the best model for the work ( @Yuchenj_UW ). Training and architecture research : Latent feedback : Feeding top-layer states back as input reaches equal loss with 15–46% less compute ( @huskydogewoof ).

title: pnnbao97/VieNeu-TTS
abstract:
🦜 VieNeu-TTS VieNeu-TTS is the next generation of on-device Vietnamese TTS: 10,000+ hours of bilingual training, instant voice cloning , a dedicated Podcast/Conversation mode, and extremely fast — real-time streaming with first audio in ~115 ms, RTF ≈ 0.01–0.02 batched on a consumer GPU (RTX 3060), ~2× real-time on a plain CPU ( benchmarks ). Important 🦜 VieNeu-TTS v4 — available on vieneu.io VieNeu-TTS v4 delivers near-original voice cloning fidelity , allowing a short reference clip to be reproduced with very high speaker similarity. Due to the strength of its voice-cloning capabilities and the potential for misuse, v4 is proprietary and will not be open-sourced . It is available exclusively through the VieNeu API / vieneu.io . VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo remains the latest open-source version available in this repository. Future open-source releases, including potential v3.x updates, may also be published here. Note 🦜 VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo is officially released! A brand-new architecture designed and trained from scratch by Phạm Nguyễn Ngọc Bảo (codec: MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer-Nano ; phonemizer: sea-g2p ): 48 kHz high-fidelity audio (up from 24 kHz). 25 built-in preset voices (10 editors' picks) — stable and consistent, no reference clip needed. Natural reading style everywhere — the style follows the reference voice (the style argument is deprecated and ignored). Emotion / non-verbal cues (experimental) : drop [cười] , [thở dài] , [hắng giọng] straight into the text. Batched generation (batch size up to 32), including a multi-speaker Conversation mode that batches the whole script regardless of speaker. Instant voice cloning from a 3–8s clip, with automatic reference denoising. Real-time streaming + OpenAI-compatible API + Docker — POST /v1/audio/speech drop-in for the OpenAI SDK / Pipecat / LiveKit; first audio in ~115 ms and 16 concurrent streams under 200 ms on a single RTX 3060 (32 max), CPU-only streaming too. See §3 , §4 Benchmarks and docs/streaming.md . LoRA fine-tuning — train your own voice or reading style on one consumer GPU ( §5 ). Try it in the Web UI (backbone "VieNeu-TTS-v3-Turbo" ) or the SDK ( Vieneu(mode="v3turbo") , the default). 🎬 Demos Tip Dubbing , Lecture , Tiktok Reel and Audiobook features are exclusively available in the official VieNeu App . This GitHub repository only provides a simplified Gradio demo interface and the core SDK for developers. Voice Cloning Demo-VieNeu-TTS.mp4 Dubbing VieNeu.Dubbing.Demo.mp4 Tiktok Reel Tr.ng.Giang.rut.kh.i.show.2.ngay.1.dem.mp4 Dubbing / Conversation His.Girl.Friday.1940.mp4 Lecture dinh-tuoi-thai-90s-logo.mp4 📌 Table of Contents 🦜 Installation & Web UI 📦 Using the Python SDK 🐳 API Server & Docker — OpenAI-compatible streaming API (v3 Turbo) · legacy v2 server 📊 Benchmarks — every speed / latency number in one place (CPU vs GPU, batch, streaming, Nano) 🎓 Fine-tuning (LoRA) 🔬 Model Overview 🚀 Roadmap 🤝 Support & Contact 📑 Citation 🦜 1. Installation & Web UI Tip On Windows? The fastest way to get started is the standalone installer at vieneu.io/#/download — no need to install uv or clone the repo manually. macOS : a similar installer is coming in an upcoming release; for now, please use the uv sync steps below. Docker? Skip the steps below: --profile api-gpu / api-cpu (OpenAI-compatible streaming API) — see §3 API Server & Docker . Setup with uv (Recommended) uv is the fastest way to manage dependencies. # Windows: powershell -c " irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex " # Linux/macOS: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh Clone the Repo: git clone https://github.com/pnnbao97/VieNeu-TTS.git cd VieNeu-TTS Install Dependencies: 📊 Which one? CPU ≈ RTF 0.5 (2× real-time, one stream) · GPU ≈ RTF 0.02 batched (~50× real-time) and 16 real-time streams — all measurements in §4 Benchmarks . Option 1: CPU & macOS (minimal, torch-free) — RTF ≈ 0.5, no GPU needed uv sync Option 2: GPU — v3 Turbo on GPU (PyTorch) — RTF ≈ 0.02 batched, 16 real-time streams uv sync --extra cuda Start the Web UI: uv run vieneu-web Access the UI at http://127.0.0.1:7860 . 📦 2. Using the Python SDK (vieneu) The vieneu SDK defaults to VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo (48 kHz) . The minimal install is torch-free : on CPU everything runs on ONNX Runtime (PyTorch is never imported), and on a CUDA machine it auto-switches to the PyTorch engine — where inference is batched automatically (same API, no code change). Quick Start CPU (default) — torch-free, runs v3 Turbo via ONNX Runtime. Most users want this — RTF ≈ 0.5 on a 12th-gen Core i5 (numbers in §4 Benchmarks ): ⚡ On CPU the backbone runs fp32 by default (maximum fidelity). Need more speed? Pass Vieneu(precision="int8") — ~1.6× faster (RTF ≈ 0.35) and ~4× smaller, but it requires a CPU with VNNI (AVX-512 VNNI / AVX-VNNI); on older CPUs int8 can produce garbled audio. precision only affects the CPU/ONNX path; on GPU it's ignored (PyTorch). 🪶 Still too slow, or deploying on a phone / ARM board? Try VieNeu-TTS v3 Nano (preview) — Vieneu(mode="v3nano") , ~3× faster than Turbo fp32 on CPU (RTF 0.11–0.22 on a desktop CPU), but noticeably lower quality (especially English / bilingual), 24 kHz, 11 preset voices + voice cloning. Details and caveats in the v3 Nano section below. pip install vieneu GPU (CUDA) — only if you have an NVIDIA GPU; ~25× faster than the CPU path (RTF ≈ 0.02 batched, 16 real-time streams — §4 Benchmarks ). On Linux pip install "vieneu[cuda]" is enough (PyPI torch ships CUDA there); on Windows install the CUDA torch first as below. ⚡ Every audio frame on GPU is one CUDA graph (acoustic decoder + sampling +
repetition penalty + backbone step in a single replay — no torch.compile , no
C++ toolchain needed). The first call for each batch size pays ~0.5 s to capture
the graph (kept afterwards; servers can call warm_fused() at start-up). VIENEU_FUSED_FRAME=0 restores the plain loop. pip install torch==2.8.0 torchaudio==2.8.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
pip install " transformers==4.57.6 " # pinned — most stable transformers for the GPU SDK pip install vieneu import time from vieneu import Vieneu # Default = v3 Turbo (48 kHz). GPU → PyTorch (auto-detected). vieneu = Vieneu () # On a GPU machine you can still switch to ONNX/CPU if you prefer: Vieneu(backend="onnx") # 1. Built-in voice by name — no reference clip needed print ( "🔊 Generating speech..." ) start_time = time . time () audio = vieneu . infer ( "[cười] Trời ơi, cái giọng nó tự nhiên mà nó mượt mà dã man, nghe không khác gì người thật luôn. Giờ thì tha hồ mà quẩy content với cả kho giọng nói đa dạng, đủ mọi sắc thái biểu cảm. Mọi người bật loa lên rồi cùng trải nghiệm thử với mình nhé!" , voice = "Phạm Tuyên" ) elapsed_time = time . time () - start_time vieneu . save ( audio , "output.wav" ) print ( "✅ Saved to output.wav" ) # Tính RTF (Real-Time Factor) sample_rate = 48000 audio_duration = len ( audio ) / sample_rate rtf = elapsed_time / audio_duration print ( f" \n ⏱️  Thời gian xử lý: { elapsed_time :.3f } s" ) print ( f"🎵 Thời lượng audio: { audio_duration :.3f } s" ) print ( f"📊 RTF: { rtf :.4f } ( { 'nhanh hơn' if rtf < 1 else 'chậm hơn' } real-time { 1 / rtf :.2f } x)" if rtf > 0 else "" ) # List the built-in voices voices = vieneu . list_preset_voices () print ( f" \n 🎙️ { len ( voices ) } built-in voices available:" ) for label , voice_id in voices : print ( f"  - { label } ( { voice_id } )" ) # 2. ⚡ Batch on GPU: infer_batch() runs many texts in ONE batched forward — same API. #    On a CUDA GPU the chunks from every text share each forward step (big throughput #    win). On CPU it still WORKS (no error) — just sequentially, so there's no batch #    gain. Batch caps at max_batch_size (default 32; tune via Vieneu(max_batch_size=64) #    or infer_batch(..., batch_size=64), or batch_size=1 to disable). A single long #    infer() also auto-batches its own chunks. For real-time use, infer_stream() is the #    streaming twin (GPU: 16 concurrent streams — see "Streaming" below).

title: 0x0funky/agent-sprite-forge
abstract: Agent Sprite Forge Languages: English | 繁體中文 | 簡體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 0.4 launch teaser: every frame is real ASF output. One still → a whole game-ready sprite set Approve one generated still. Get every action of the character, keyed, looped, timed and exported for your engine. Agent skills for Claude Code (plugin), Codex and Grok . The agent generates a master still with the best image route you have, makes one image-to-video clip per action from it, and deterministic Python tools gate, key, register, loop, retime, finish and package every action for Godot, Aseprite or a web game. 1. One approved master still Generated by the local Codex CLI ( image_gen ), take 1 of 3. 2. Six actions, one image-to-video clip each Grok image-to-video (local CLI), soft-matte keyed, registered, loops picked by measurement, one-shots retimed to game speed, HD finish with the colour lock. Real timing. 3. In a scene: the packaged run, attack and idle over a generated background. The run speed is measured from the contact foot, so the feet do not slide. Every frame comes from the 2026-10-06 live run; nothing is mocked up. Pixel looks · Hibit style · What's new · Quickstart · Routes and providers · Pipeline · Maps · Showcase · Tools New: pixel looks, 1x sprites that follow a reference A whole fight from pixel-look sprites, rendered at 1x and shown at 2x: four 1x characters (masters of 33x55 to 87x86) and 14 sets with 168 drawings read back from image-to-video clips. The plate behind them is a generated painting brought down to 384x216 and 40 colours. The white hit flashes and the knight's fade are the demo's; nothing else is added. An image model asked for pixel art paints a picture of pixels: blocks of uneven size (15 to 30 px in the picture below), 88,410 colours in one small figure, soft edges. Shrinking it does not help: resized plainly to the sprite's size it still has 1,033 colours. Hibit gets round this by never asking for pixel art. Pixel looks go the other way, for the classic small sprite that follows a look you like: the look is never described in words, one sprite you like is the reference for the whole cast, and the picture the model paints is read back onto a real grid. pixel_look.py master finds the picture's own grid, takes one flat colour from every block, keeps the figure's proportions, brings the colours down to a palette and closes the outline by rule. What comes out can be counted: 33x55 pixels, 48 colours, alpha 0 or 255, a 2.5 KB PNG. What the image model painted 1254x1254 px. The figure alone has 88,410 colours and its blocks are 15 to 30 px: no grid fits it. Resized plainly to 33x55 Nearest sampling, shown at 7x: 1,033 colours, the ground's green left in 3 cells. Bilinear gives 1,275 colours and 413 soft pixels. pixel_look.py master The same picture read on its own grid, shown at 7x: 33x55, 48 colours, no soft pixel. The same part of the face: the picture at 2x (left) and the sprite at 40x (right). The cast follows the first sprite. Every further character is drawn beside the first sprite in one picture ( ask-cast , cast ), so it keeps the pixel size and stands as tall: a mage, a skeleton knight and a frost dragon, 48 colours each. Poses, views and motion from the master. A pose is the master reproduced with one change (the sword pose: 217 cells changed, 91% of the master kept); a view is drawn beside the master. Motion comes from an image-to-video clip of that sprite: pixel_motion.py reads every frame back on the sprite's lattice and palette (the attack: 21 drawings picked from 145 video frames). The number is the drawings of each set. Measured on the run (2026-11-12) The swordsman's generated picture (the figure) 1254x1254, 88,410 colours, blocks 15-30 px The same picture resized to 33x55: nearest / bilinear 1,033 colours / 1,275 colours and 413 soft pixels pixel_look.py master 33x55, 48 colours, 0 soft pixels, 2.5 KB The cast: mage / skeleton knight / frost dragon 45x56 / 50x55 / 87x86, 48 colours each The sword pose from the master 217 cells changed, 91% of the master kept The attack set from one clip 21 drawings from 145 video frames The fight 14 sets, 168 drawings; every drawing has only its sprite's own colours and no soft pixel What's new: pixel_look.py (generate2dsprite): ask-master and master draw the figure you like again, alone and large, and read it as the 1x master; ask-cast and cast draw every further character beside the master; ask-pose , pose , ask-view and view make poses and side or back views from the master; lineup puts everything on one ground line and reports the heights. pixel_motion.py (video2dsprite): prepare , frames , finish , measure , breath : the frames of an image-to-video clip read back on the sprite's lattice and palette, a loop or an action picked from them, and an animation.json 3.0 package with nearest sampling. Only on request. Nothing else changes: the HD, pixel and hibit finishes and their defaults are untouched. The reference sets the look (pixel size, shading, outline); the characters are your own. The whole route, what you accept and when, and its limits: references/pixel-looks.md . New: hibit, real pixel art from flat AI art Pip's Star Grove, a one-screen demo built only from hibit output: autopilot gameplay captured from the game canvas (480x270, shown at 2x). FX: pixelfx by Patch (MIT). Never ask an image model for "pixel art": it paints fake, uneven pixels. The hibit style asks it for clean flat lineless art (at most 3 tones per material, no outlines) and makes the pixels afterwards: one palette per character learned from the source pixels, an 8x8 majority-vote downscale (every pixel is the palette colour that covered most of its cell, never a blend), hysteresis against flicker, eyes and glints kept, binary alpha, and a 1 px outline whose colour comes from the sprite itself. Flat art in, pixel art out The approved master (Codex) and the hibit finish of the idle at 80 px: 16 colours learned from the source plus the outline colour, which --outline auto takes from the sprite's dominant hue (#380500, a deep red-brown from the orange fur). Never a fixed orange. Whole sets, one palette per character Pip (idle, walk, cast, hurt) and a magma slime (idle, crawl, attack): Grok image-to-video clips through sprite_set.py --finish hibit , 12 fps. Every action reuses the first action's palette and outline. FX: pixelfx (recommended) or the image route For hibit effects we recommend pixelfx by Patch: a library of code-driven pixel-art effects (fire, arcane, impacts, weather, pickups, UI) that fits the style and renders for free on your machine. It is a separate MIT project: clone it yourself ( git clone https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx , Node 18+) and the skill finds it. fx_pixelfx.py check picks the route; a route you name wins. A: pixelfx installed (recommended) B: image route (always available) Frames per effect 16-91 at 30 fps 4 (one 2x2 sheet) Cost free (local Node) one generated image per effect Look pixelfx's own style, recoloured with --ramp and --snap your game's flat style and palette Credit every render ships CREDITS.txt (pixelfx's MIT license and notice) the image route, like every sprite A: pixelfx arcane/star-fall recoloured to Pip's palette, impacts/hit-spark , spawn/poof , spawn/coin-drop . title: microsoft/PyRIT
abstract:
PyRIT: AI red teaming for models and applications PyRIT (Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI) is an open-source toolkit
for finding security and safety weaknesses in generative AI systems through automated
scans, adaptive multi-turn attacks, and human-led testing. Built by the Microsoft AI Red Team and an open-source community of contributors,
PyRIT brings a command-line scanner, a graphical interface, and an extensible
Python framework together in one toolkit. You do not need to be a Microsoft employee or an experienced red teamer to get involved.
Join our Discord community to ask questions, exchange
techniques, share what you are building, and connect with maintainers and other users. Contributions include code, documentation, examples, bug reports, testing, and feedback
from real-world use. Read the contributor guide and
explore issues labeled "help wanted" . Get started | Join Discord | Read the whitepaper Explore PyRIT Scanner : Run repeatable assessments from the command line. CoPyRIT GUI : Explore AI systems interactively and review results in your browser. Python framework : Compose and extend components to build custom red teaming workflows. Visit our website for installation, configuration,
demos, and documentation. Use the version picker to match the docs to your installation;
the guides above follow the latest development version. Models and systems Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning,

title: mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
abstract:
Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills The largest open-source cybersecurity skills library for AI agents 818 production-grade cybersecurity skills · 34 security domains · 6 framework mappings · 26+ AI platforms Get Started · What's Inside · Frameworks · Platforms · Contributing ⚠️ Community Project — This is an independent, community-created project. Not affiliated with Anthropic PBC. 🔐 Authorized & lawful use only. This library includes offensive and dual-use techniques (e.g. red-team C2, phishing simulation, exploitation) intended for authorized penetration testing, security research, defense, and education . Only use them against systems you own or have explicit written permission to test, and comply with all applicable laws and rules of engagement. You are solely responsible for how you use these skills. See SECURITY.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md . Give any AI agent the security skills of a senior analyst A junior analyst knows which Volatility3 plugin to run on a suspicious memory dump, which Sigma rules catch Kerberoasting, and how to scope a cloud breach across three providers. Your AI agent doesn't — unless you give it these skills. This repo contains 818 structured cybersecurity skills spanning 34 security domains , each following the agentskills.io open standard.  The library maps across six industry frameworks — MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, MITRE D3FEND, NIST AI RMF, and the MITRE Fight Fraud Framework (F3) — with each skill mapped to the frameworks relevant to its type (a forensics skill carries ATT&CK + CSF; an AI-security skill adds ATLAS and AI RMF).  Clone it, point your agent at it, and your next security investigation gets expert-level guidance in seconds. Six frameworks, one skill library Each skill maps to the frameworks that fit its subject — ATT&CK and NIST CSF are near-universal, while ATLAS, AI RMF, D3FEND, and F3 apply where they're relevant. Framework coverage across the 817 skills: MITRE ATT&CK 805 · NIST CSF 2.0 804 · MITRE D3FEND 139 · NIST AI RMF 97 · MITRE F3 94 · MITRE ATLAS 93 . Framework Version Framework scope What it maps MITRE ATT&CK v19.1 15 tactics · Enterprise/Mobile/ICS Adversary behaviors and TTPs NIST CSF 2.0 2.0 6 functions · 22 categories · 106 subcategories Organizational security posture MITRE ATLAS 2026.07 101 techniques · 77 sub-techniques AI/ML adversarial threats MITRE D3FEND v1.4.0 270 techniques Defensive countermeasures NIST AI RMF 1.0 4 functions (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage) AI risk management MITRE F3 (Fight Fraud Framework) v1.1 (2026-04-09) 8 tactics · 123 techniques · 94 fraud-relevant skills Cyber-enabled financial fraud TTPs Example — each skill maps only to the frameworks relevant to it (one may hit all six, another just a couple): Skill ATT&CK NIST CSF ATLAS D3FEND AI RMF F3 analyzing-network-traffic-of-malware T1071 DE.CM AML.T0047 D3-NTA MEASURE-2.6 — detecting-business-email-compromise T1566 DE.AE — — — F1005.006 · monetization 🆕 MITRE Fight Fraud Framework (F3) — 94 fraud-relevant skills The MITRE Fight Fraud Framework (F3) was released April 9, 2026 by MITRE's Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID), co-developed with JPMorganChase, Citigroup, Lloyds Banking Group, Standard Chartered, CrowdStrike, Verizon Business, FS-ISAC, and others. It is an ATT&CK-compatible TTP catalog for cyber-enabled financial fraud — filling the gap ATT&CK leaves after initial compromise. F3 v1.1 adds two fraud-specific tactics that ATT&CK does not enumerate: Positioning ( FA0001 ) — actions taken after access to collect/manipulate data and prepare the fraud (synthetic-identity seeding, account warming, beneficiary setup, SIM-swap pre-positioning, banking-session hijack). Monetization ( FA0002 ) — converting stolen assets into usable funds (money-mule layering, APP fraud, crypto off-ramping, card cash-out, refund/chargeback abuse). Fraud-specific techniques use F1XXX IDs (e.g. F1005.003 Add Beneficiary, F1025.003 Wire Transfer, F1007 Adversary-in-the-Browser); reused ATT&CK techniques keep their T1XXX IDs. Mappings live in each skill's mitre_f3: frontmatter block — all 123 F3 v1.1 technique IDs were verified against the upstream STIX bundle. See docs/mitre-f3-mapping.md for the schema. MITRE ATT&CK v19.1 — 805/817 skills mapped Every skill carries a mitre_attack frontmatter list validated against MITRE ATT&CK v19.1 (the latest release) using the official mitreattack-python library — 290 distinct techniques and sub-techniques (146 base + 144 sub) across Enterprise, ICS, and Mobile. Zero revoked or deprecated IDs. v19.1's restructured Defense Evasion (now split into Stealth and Defense Impairment ) is reflected below. Tactic ID Skills Reconnaissance TA0043 103 Resource Development TA0042 22 Initial Access TA0001 467 Execution TA0002 350 Persistence TA0003 444 Privilege Escalation TA0004 464 Stealth TA0005 442 Defense Impairment TA0112 92 Credential Access TA0006 202 Discovery TA0007 237 Lateral Movement TA0008 68 Collection TA0009 172 Command and Control TA0011 123 Exfiltration TA0010 82 Impact TA0040 50 Quick start # Option 1: npx (recommended) npx skills add mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills # Option 2: Git clone git clone https://github.com/mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills.git cd Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills Works immediately with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any agentskills.io -compatible platform. 🌍 GARS-2026 — Global Agentic AI Readiness Survey I'm running a global academic study measuring how ready security professionals,
developers, and enterprise teams actually are for agentic AI — MCP servers,
tool calling, governance, and human-in-the-loop workflows. If you use this repo, your response would be a genuinely valuable data point. 📋 Take the survey (10 min): Survey Link 60 questions · Anonymous · Supervised by SRH Berlin You get 50 Casky Tokens for early access to casky.ai Results published open access under CC-BY 4.0 🚀 Try it on the Playground Experience Casky.ai hands-on — no setup required. → Launch Playground on Casky.ai The playground lets you: Run live cybersecurity skill exercises against real targets See AI agents execute structured skills in real time Explore MITRE ATT&CK mapped workflows interactively Test threat hunting, DFIR, and penetration testing scenarios No installation. No configuration. Just open and start. Why this exists The cybersecurity workforce gap hit 4.8 million unfilled roles globally in 2024 (ISC2). AI agents can help close that gap — but only if they have structured domain knowledge to work from. Today's agents can write code and search the web, but they lack the practitioner playbooks that turn a generic LLM into a capable security analyst. Existing security tool repos give you wordlists, payloads, or exploit code. None of them give an AI agent the structured decision-making workflow a senior analyst follows: when to use each technique, what prerequisites to check, how to execute step-by-step, and how to verify results. That is the gap this project fills. Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills is not a collection of scripts or checklists. It is an AI-native knowledge base built from the ground up for the agentskills.io standard  — YAML frontmatter for sub-second discovery, structured Markdown for step-by-step execution, and reference files for deep technical context.  Every skill encodes real practitioner workflows, not generated summaries.

title: SigmaHQ/sigma
abstract: Sigma - Generic Signature Format for SIEM Systems Welcome to the Sigma main rule repository. The place where detection engineers, threat hunters and all defensive security practitioners collaborate on detection rules. The repository offers more than 3000 detection rules of different type and aims to make reliable detections accessible to all at no cost. Currently the repository offers three types of rules: Generic Detection Rules - Are threat agnostic, their aim is to detect a behavior or an implementation of a technique or procedure that was, can or will be used by a potential threat actor. Threat Hunting Rules - Are broader in scope and are meant to give the analyst a starting point to hunt for potential suspicious or malicious activity Emerging Threat Rules - Are rules that cover specific threats, that are timely and relevant for certain periods of time. These threats include specific APT campaigns, exploitation of Zero-Day vulnerabilities, specific malware used during an attack,...etc. Compliance Rules - Are rules that help you identify compliance violations based on well known security frameworks such as CIS Controls, NIST, ISO 27001,...etc. Placeholder Rules - Are rules that get their final meaning at conversion or usage time of the rule. Explore Sigma To start exploring the Sigma ecosystem, please visit the official website sigmahq.io What is Sigma Sigma is a generic and open signature format that allows you to describe relevant log events in a straightforward manner. The rule format is very flexible, easy to write and applicable to any type of log file. The main purpose of this project is to provide a structured form in which researchers or analysts can describe their once developed detection methods and make them shareable with others. Sigma is for log files what Snort is for network traffic and YARA is for files. Why Sigma Today, everyone collects log data for analysis. People start working on their own, processing numerous white papers, blog posts and log analysis guidelines, extracting the necessary information and build their own searches and dashboard. Some of their searches and correlations are great and very useful but they lack a standardized format in which they can share their work with others. Others provide excellent analyses, include IOCs and YARA rules to detect the malicious files and network connections, but have no way to describe a specific or generic detection method in log events. Sigma is meant to be an open standard in which such detection mechanisms can be defined, shared and collected in order to improve the detection capabilities for everyone. 🌟 Key Features A continuously growing list of detection and hunting rules, peer reviewed by a community of professional Detection Engineers. Vendor agnostic detection rules. Easily shareable across communities and reports 🏗️ Rule Creation To start writing Sigma rules please check the following getting started guide along with the sigma specification: Getting Started Guide Sigma Specification 🔎 Contributing & Making PRs Please refer to the CONTRIBUTING guide for detailed instructions on how you can start contributing new rules. 📦 Rule Packages You can download the latest rule packages from the release page and start leveraging Sigma rules today. New rules are also released on a regular basis, so check back often for the latest detections. 🧬 Rule Usage and Conversion You can start converting Sigma rules today using: Sigma CLI - the official command-line converter sigconverter.io - web-based GUI converter Detection Studio - web-based GUI converter To integrate Sigma rules in your own toolchain or products use pySigma . 🚨 Reporting False Positives or New Rule Ideas If you find a false positive or would like to propose a new detection rule idea but do not have the time to create one, please create a new issue on the GitHub repository by selecting one of the available templates. 💬 Community Join the Sigma community on Discord to discuss detection engineering, ask questions, share ideas, and collaborate with other practitioners. We also use Discord for announcements such as new releases and other project updates. 🌐 Official Resources sigmahq.io - Official Sigma website SigmaHQ Blog - Official blog covering detection engineering, rule releases, and Sigma updates Phoenix - Sigma Rule Intelligence Platform - Search, analyze, and understand Sigma rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK 📚 Resources & Further Reading Hack.lu 2017 Sigma - Generic Signatures for Log Events by Thomas Patzke Sigma - Generic Signatures for SIEM Systems by Florian Roth 50 Shades of Sigma by Florian Roth Introducing Sigma Specification v2.0 by Nasreddine Bencherchali SIGMA-Resources - Curated list of resources to learn and understand Sigma rules The Ultimate Guide to Sigma Rules by Graylog Introduction to Sigma Rules by Intezer Projects or Products that use or integrate Sigma rules AlphaSOC - Leverages Sigma rules to increase coverage across all supported log sources alterix - Converts Sigma rules to the query language of CRYPTTECH's SIEM AttackIQ - Sigma Rules integrated in AttackIQ's platform, and SigmAIQ for Sigma rule conversion and LLM apps Atomic Threat Coverage - Automatically maps Sigma rules to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, Atomic Red Team tests, and incident response playbooks (since December 2018) ATR (Agent Threat Rules) - Open MIT-licensed detection rule format for AI agent security threats (prompt injection, tool poisoning, context exfiltration). Reference CLI exports ATR rules to Sigma format via atr convert sigma . AttackRuleMap - Maps Atomic Red Team attack simulations to open-source Sigma detection rules for coverage assessment Confluent Sigma - Kafka Streams supported Sigma rules Detection Studio - Convert Sigma rules to any supported SIEM Exeon.UEBA - User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) solution from Exeon which provides a built-in Sigma detection engine HAWK.io MDR - Managed detection and response platform that runs Sigma rules as native detections, converted with the open-source pySigma-backend-hawk IBM QRadar - Natively ingests Sigma rules for real-time detection via the YARA and Sigma Rules Manager app Joe Sandbox - Automated malware analysis platform that applies Sigma rules during sandbox execution to detect threats in behavioral logs LimaCharlie - SecOps cloud platform with native Sigma rule support and automatic conversion to its Detection & Response rule format MISP - Open-source threat intelligence sharing platform with native Sigma rule support (since version 2.4.70, March 2017) Nextron's Aurora Agent - Lightweight Sigma-based EDR agent using ETW for real-time endpoint detection Nextron's THOR Scanner - Scan with Sigma rules on endpoints RANK VASA - AI-based network threat detection platform that uses Sigma rules to identify security anomalies for MSSPs Saeros - Open-source HIDS for Windows and Active Directory with local Sigma rule matching via ETW Security Onion - Open-source network security monitoring platform with built-in Sigma detection and automatic daily rule updates Sekoia.io XDR - XDR supporting Sigma and Sigma Correlation rules languages sigma2stix - Converts the entire SigmaHQ Ruleset into STIX 2.

title: bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD
abstract: Agile Ai Driven Development — turn an idea or change request into working software without giving up the thinking. Ai Driven Development (AiDD) covers the whole effort, not only the code: what to build, how it holds together, and how it changes as you learn. BMad Method is the agile way to do it — decisions stay explicit, context carries forward, and the process sizes itself to the work. Small changes go straight to build. Complex work gets the depth it needs. The same method covers a weekend prototype and a system with years of history behind it. Start anywhere. Use BMad end to end, or carry its briefs, specifications, and architecture into your existing delivery workflow. Start Building BMad ships on two lines. The stable release is v6.12 , installed by the npm installer and frozen aside from bug fixes. V7 is in preview alpha on this branch: its skills, install path, and docs change often. The v7 release ETA is mid-November 2026, and it might be sooner. Both routes need uv for BMad setup and Python scripts. Stable: v6.12 (recommended if stability is needed until v7 is finalized for release) With Node.js 20.12+ and Python 3.10+, run in your project: npx bmad-method install Open your project in your AI coding tool, invoke bmad-build with what you want to change, and run bmad-help whenever you want guidance on what comes next. The v6.12 source and documentation live on the V6.12 branch . V7 Preview Alpha (recommended for solo or small teams that can pivot as things will change before beta) Expect breaking changes between updates. You need an AI coding tool that supports skills. With Node.js and npm and Git, run in your project to install core tools and BMad Method: npx skills add bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD/skills/core-tools --skill ' * ' npx skills add bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD/skills/method --skill ' * ' Each command installs one module whole and asks which coding tools to install to. Core tools hold the bmad skill for setup and help, so every install needs them. Optional modules install the same way: Module What it adds Install Toolsmith Smithy builds, converts, reviews and packages skills, agents and modules; bmad-eval measures them npx skills add bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD/skills/toolsmith --skill '*' Founder Nadia the Founder Advisor coaches the business side of a startup, from idea and pricing to fundraising npx skills add bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD/skills/founder To pick single skills instead, run npx skills add bmad-code-org/BMAD-METHOD and include bmad plus the record of each module you take skills from, such as bmod-core-tools and bmod-method . Open your coding tool in the project and ask the bmad skill to run bmad setup . Then invoke bmad-build with what you want to change. Ask bmad whenever you want guidance on what comes next or what is optional. Ask for bmad status to check versions and see what to run next. Ask for bmad setup to install updates: it runs npx skills update , then refreshes the project and cleans up renamed and removed skills. Report preview problems in GitHub Issues or on Discord . Next steps Build your first project with BMad → Add BMad to an existing codebase → BMad is free and open source, with no paywalled workflows or gated community. Why BMad? Coding assistants are effective at implementation, but they often turn unstated assumptions into code. BMad keeps you in control while its agents and workflows make the important decisions explicit and preserve them as context for the work that follows. Right-sized process — Go directly to implementation for clear changes or add deeper planning for larger initiatives. New or existing code — Start from nothing, or establish verified context on a codebase you inherited and work from what is actually there. Durable context — Carry product and technical decisions forward instead of re-explaining them in every chat. Specialized perspectives — Bring in product, architecture, UX, development, and testing expertise when it helps. Guided collaboration — Use structured workflows and multiple-agent discussions without handing over judgment. One delivery path — Move from early thinking through reviewed implementation, correction, and learning. See how much planning a change needs → BMad Ecosystem Install the core method or add official modules for specialized work. title: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
abstract:
AG-UI: The Agent-User Interaction Protocol AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.
Built for simplicity and flexibility, it enables seamless integration between AI agents, real time user context, and user interfaces. Join our Discord → Read the Docs → Go to the AG-UI Dojo → Follow us → 🚀 Getting Started Create a new AG-UI application in seconds: npx create-ag-ui-app my-agent-app Useful Links: The AG-UI Dojo Build AG-UI-powered applications(Quickstart) Build new AG-UI framework integrations (Quickstart) Book a call to discuss an AG-UI integration with a new framework Join the Discord Community What is AG-UI? AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol for agent-human interaction, designed for simplicity & flexibility: During agent executions, agent backends emit events compatible with one of AG-UI's ~16 standard event types Agent backends can accept one of a few simple AG-UI compatible inputs as arguments AG-UI includes a flexible middleware layer that ensures compatibility across diverse environments: Works with any event transport (SSE, WebSockets, webhooks, etc.) Allows for loose event format matching , enabling broad agent and app interoperability It also ships with a reference HTTP implementation and default connector to help teams get started fast. Learn more about the specs → Why AG-UI? AG-UI was developed based on real-world requirements and practical experience building in-app agent interactions. Where does AGUI fit in the agentic protocol stack? AG-UI is complementary to the other 2 top agentic protocols MCP gives agents tools A2A allows agents to communicate with other agents AG-UI brings agents into user-facing applications 🚀 Features 💬 Real-time agentic chat with streaming 🔄 Bi-directional state synchronization 🧩 Generative UI and structured messages 🧠 Real-time context enrichment 🛠️ Frontend tool integration 🧑‍💻 Human-in-the-loop collaboration 🛠 Supported Integrations AG-UI was born from CopilotKit's initial partnership with LangChain and CrewAI - and brings the incredibly popular agent-user-interactivity infrastructure to the wider agentic ecosystem. 1st party = the platforms that have AG‑UI built in and provide documentation for guidance.
